question: The Dogri language is primarily associated with which of the following Indian states/UTs?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Dogri language** is primarily associated with **Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
• It is an Indo-Aryan language.
 
• The people who speak the Dogri language are called Duggar.
 
• Dogri was recognized as an official language of India by including it in the 8th schedule of the Indian Constitution.
